basic_profile.bio: I'm a 41-year-old robotics enthusiast based in Austin, Texas. By day, I'm a software engineer working on IoT projects, and by night, I indulge in my passion for LEGO Mindstorms and retro gaming. I'm happily married with two kids, who I often introduce to the wonders of robotics and coding. I typically spend my online time in the evenings, after work and family time. My interests include tinkering with electronics, discovering vintage tech, and exploring the latest in AI developments.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science and have over 15 years of experience in software development, focusing primarily on embedded systems. My interest in robotics started in college, and I've been self-teaching myself various robotics platforms ever since. I frequently attend tech meetups and workshops to stay updated with the latest advancements.
